description: Overall heat transfer coefficients for a first estimate of heat exchanger areas, per comparable cell: exchanger type and construction, fluid group and phase of the hot and the cold stream, area basis. U is the median of the representative values of a cell (a reported value, the midpoint of a reported range or the median of tabulated values), range the lowest and the highest published value, n_sources the number of independent sources. Where two cells share exchanger type, phases and fluids, the one marked default is used. Only cells of one zone are listed; whole-exchanger averages over several zones, generic fluid groups, refinery streams, model assumptions and secondary citations are left out.

sources.Perry2008: Shilling et al. (2008), Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook
sources.Roetzel2010: Roetzel and Spang (2010), VDI Heat Atlas C3
